checks.must: Polling still runs only once under tests (the Ember.testing guard) or otherwise keeps settled() from hanging (test waiter + stop in tests); an unconditional setInterval/setTimeout loop fails unless flagged.
Polling stops when the component is destroyed/unmounted.
Unread notifications still come through the Ember Data store with the current user's id from the session service, or the change is flagged.
The onRead closure action passed from application.hbs is still called with the unread count before resetting it.
The span.bell wrapper with bell--unread class when unread > 0 is preserved.
No unrequested behaviour changes (e.g. drop() concurrency, 20 s interval) without calling them out.
